history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V33 workload, representation, width, job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, attribution counter, mixed-tier replay signature, timing boundary, occupancy rule, native runner, and publication ruling. It changes no scored row or production engine behavior. It versions explicit direct versus shared-overlay binary provenance and re-pins only the corresponding evidence schemas and validators. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Adds attribution-v4 and growth-v4 with an explicit provenance mode. Direct binary revisions must equal the logical revisions and carry no overlay paths. Shared overlays retain one-commit ancestry, non-empty symmetric changes, the complete frozen path inventory, and effective blob equality. Both modes verify identical workload-source blobs in both binary revisions and the current checkout. Version 1 through 3 artifacts retain their original rules; no dummy overlay commits or schema downgrades are needed for new direct-build experiments.

exact_parent_integration.publication_boundary: V34 preserves every V33 timing, efficiency, cleanliness, checksum, serial-child, process-classification, native-runner, and mixed-tier allocation-replay gate. New exact-parent and growth artifacts require explicit direct or shared-overlay provenance. Missing, mixed, stale, or ambiguous identities are refused. Historical artifact contracts and all scored workload definitions remain unchanged.
